brief_summary:
The purpose of this study is to compare the effectiveness, safety of SYH2053 in Participants with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia.

A total of 156 Participants were actually enrolled
brief_title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety, Efficacy of SYH2053 in Chinese Participants With Non-familial Hypercholesterolemia and Mixed Hyperlipidemia
official_title: A Phase Ⅱ Randomized, Parallel-group, Placebo-controlled, Active-controlled Trial to Assess the Efficacy, Safety of the SYH2053 Subcutaneous Injection in Participants With Primary Hypercholesterolemia or Mixed Dyslipidemia

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage change in LDL-C relative to baseline
